messages:
sara: starting a config-only deploy now — bumping routing weight floor + tightening idle timeout and small batching tweak. canary = 5% for 10m.

sara: changes: routing.weight_floor=0.05, idle_timeout_ms=120, batching.max_batch_tokens=2048, batching.max_latency_ms=15

sara: pinning model-version to v2.3.1 (config only, no model swap).

deploy-bot: queued deploy 6483201111 by sara (change-window: 2026-03-22T02:05Z -> 2026-03-22T02:15Z). canary: 5% -> 10m -> then 50% for 5m -> full.

lee: ack. I'll watch latency P70/P95 on the canary shards.

nina: @lee add kvcache hit-rate and overall token/sec, too. last time we saw kvcache drop at 7% when weight_floor low.

ops-sre: noted. setting alert: kvcache_hit_rate < 0.88 for >2m -> auto-rollback. also CPU util>80% on inference-nodes -> alert.

sara: thanks. if anything spikes, manual rollback plan: unpin routing, revert routing.weight_floor=0.1 and batching.* back to prev.

kim: can you paste the small snippet i'm supposed to apply to tenant overrides? i don't want to apply wrong flags mid-canary.

sara: sure — here's the tenant override we will push to canary cohort (dev-tenant-group-B):

```
overrides:
  routing:
    weight_floor: 0.05
  timeouts:
    idle_ms: 120
  batching:
    max_batch_tokens: 2048
    max_latency_ms: 15
```

sam: thumbsup. I'll keep an eye on model v2.3.1 KV cache logs.

deploy-bot: canary stage started (5% -> cohort dev-tenant-group-B). started_at=6483201120. expected_promote_at=6483201720.

lee: initial P50/P95 stable. P95 +12ms vs baseline. no obvious queuing.
nina: kvcache_hit_rate 0.915 on canary, token/sec ~ 12k, CPU ~ 58%. Good so far.

ops-sre: adding temporary traffic-shaper rule in case of sudden surge: max_inflight_per_tenant=30 for cohort-B.

sara: roll to 50% in 5m if metrics stable. otherwise hold and triage.

(7m later)

lee: small uptick in tail latency on one AZ: P99 +80ms but isolated to az-us-west-2b.
nina: kvcache hit-rate dropped to 0.86 in that AZ. could be coldstart or cache eviction.

ops-sre: isolating nodes in us-west-2b from promotion cohort. pausing rollout.
sara: pausing — deploy-bot pause. leaving canary at 5% and pausing promote.

deploy-bot: rollout paused by sara at 6483201481. reason: P99 tail in us-west-2b, kvcache_hit_rate degraded.

sam: quick check — heapster logs show gc storms on a subset of infra pods after the weight_floor drop; investigating eviction thresholds.

lee: suggestion: revert idle_timeout_ms to previous (150) for the AZ only via routing AZ override and re-evaluate.
sara: agree. apply AZ override to restore idle_ms=150 for us-west-2b, leave cohort otherwise.

kim: pushed AZ override patch. small patch id 6483201489.

ops-sre: monitoring — kvcache_hit_rate recovering to 0.9, P99 tail dropping.

lee: P95 back to baseline, P99 improved.
sara: good. we can either resume or rollback fully. prefer resume with slower ramp: 5% -> 20% for 10m -> 50% for 10m -> full.

nina: +1 to slower ramp. I'll keep a set of synthetic prompts handy for quality checks (prompt-set: sanity-basic, hallucination-smoke).

deploy-bot: resume requested by sara. new plan: 5% -> 20% (10m) -> 50% (10m) -> full. starting at 6483201550.

(10m later)

lee: 20% stage stable. metrics look fine across AZs.

sara: promote to 50% then wait 10m.

(another 10m)

nina: quality checks pass on sanity-basic, hallucination-smoke unchanged. no regressions.

ops-sre: infra stable. minor CPU bump but <70%.

sara: rolling to full now. final note: release notes updated — config-only, no model change, intent: reduce latency for small requests and enforce stricter weight floor to lower noisy tail.

deploy-bot: rollout complete at 6483202365. all cohorts updated. status=SUCCESS.

sara: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short postmortem if we see any residual flapping, but closing this thread. :tada:
